anchors.description: Black-framed wall-mounted manual pull-down projection screen; endpoints are the top-left and bottom-right outer corners of the screen frame.
anchors.visible_evidence: White viewing surface with black border and bottom weight bar, typical 4:3 manual pull-down conference-room screen mounted on the wall above the table; opposite frame corners chosen as endpoints.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Brand/model not legible; nominal viewing diagonal likely 100 in (2.54 m, outer frame diagonal ~2.7 m), plausible 92-120 in range; 4:3 inferred from ~1.3 aspect of the white area.
